summary: Both backend and frontend tested for the new IMAGE attachment feature in the admin test editor. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed in 25.9s covering POST /api/admin/upload-image (auth, non-admin forbidden, empty file 400, happy path returning {image_id,url}), GET /api/files/{id} (public streaming + 404 unknown), full persistence round-trip through POST /api/admin/tests -> GET /api/admin/tests/{id} and GET /api/tests/{id}?practice=true (question_image_en/hi + option_images_en/hi returned byte-identical), image-only option accepted, bulk-upload-tagged regression intact, no-image question regression intact, and submit scoring correct for an image-containing question. Frontend: logged in as admin, loaded /admin/test-editor?testId=test_5380a0a225 (seeded 'Image Demo Test'), confirmed all required testIDs (qimg-en-0-replace/remove, qimg-hi-0-add, optimg-en-0-0-replace/remove, optimg-hi-0-0-add, save-test, add-question). File-pick upload path verified via Playwright file chooser: uploading a 4x4 green PNG into qimg-hi-0 flipped the field from 'Add image' to Replace+Remove with preview rendered; clicking Remove restored 'Add image'. Student exam at /exam/test_5380a0a225 rendered question-image under the question and option-image-0 inside option A (text 'Red' + red image), option-1 showed only text 'Blue', options C/D were correctly SKIPPED (neither text nor image). Selecting option A and submitting scored 1/1 (100% accuracy) and routed to /results/att_... All image-related features work end to end. Clipboard paste (web-only enhancement) was NOT exercised in Playwright (as explicitly allowed by the request); the paste handler is wired in test-editor.tsx:123-149 and attaches to the last-focused field via focusedRef.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now at 1689 lines (grew by ~90 for image routes). Still over the 700-line soft limit — splitting into routers/{images,admin_tests,bulk_upload}.py is a nice-to-have cleanup for next iteration.
exam/[id].tsx:189 — optImg fallback (lang=='hi' empty -> fallback to option_images_en[i]) is correct and matches question-image fallback at line 187. Nice symmetry.
admin/test-editor.tsx:174-184 — hasQ() and optFilled() correctly accept 'option considered filled if text OR image', aligning with the student renderer that skips options only when both are empty.

upload-image uses await file.read() of the whole payload before size check — fine for the 6MB cap but if the cap is ever raised, consider streaming or reading up to limit+1 to short-circuit DoS. Not blocking.
No MIME-sniffing beyond extension; a malicious .png actually containing non-image bytes would be stored and served with 'image/*' content-type. Low risk since route is admin-only, flagging only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (editor load, upload, preview, remove, exam render, scoring)
